name: Account balance note through the accounts API
step_description: Sign in to the Ghostfolio instance, open the browser developer tools and copy the Bearer token from the Authorization header of any api/v1 request; note the id of a cash account from GET /api/v1/accounts.
description: Checks the comment added to account balances in commit bdf122a: create with a note, keep the note on an update without a comment field and refuse a note over 2000 characters.

step_description: POST /api/v1/accounts/<accountId>/balances with the Bearer token and body {"balance":1234.56,"date":"<today>","comment":"Deposit of the annual savings"}.
HTTP 201; GET /api/v1/accounts/<accountId>/balances lists today's balance with value 1234.56 and comment "Deposit of the annual savings".
POST the same URL with {"balance":2000,"date":"<today>"} (no comment field), then POST again with a comment of 2001 characters.

The first call returns HTTP 201 and today's balance is now 2000 with the comment unchanged (still one row for today); the second returns HTTP 400 with "comment must be shorter than or equal to 2000 characters".

name: MCP OAuth discovery documents and 401 challenge
step_description: Start the api with ENABLE_FEATURE_MCP=true, ENABLE_FEATURE_MCP_OAUTH=true and ROOT_URL set to the public HTTPS URL of the instance with a trailing slash (for example https://<host>/).
description: Checks the RFC 8414 and RFC 9728 documents of commit 157e425 and the WWW-Authenticate challenge of the MCP authorization middleware. Needs an HTTPS ROOT_URL; left in phase New until the UAT instance has one.

step_description: GET https://<host>/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server.

HTTP 200 JSON with issuer "https://<host>" (no trailing slash), token_endpoint "https://<host>/api/v1/oauth/token", authorization_endpoint "https://<host>/oauth/authorize", code_challenge_methods_supported ["S256"] and token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported ["none"].
GET https://<host>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp, then POST https://<host>/mcp without an Authorization header.

The first returns {"authorization_servers":["https://<host>"],"resource":"https://<host>/mcp","resource_name":"Ghostfolio"}; the second returns HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Bearer realm="Ghostfolio", resource_metadata="https://<host>/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp" and the message "A valid access is required as a bearer token".

name: Upgrade Plan button only with a Stripe price id
step_description: Sign in as a Basic user on an instance with ENABLE_FEATURE_SUBSCRIPTION=true whose offer has no Stripe price id, and open /en/account/membership.
description: Checks the client fix of commit 4fc9c2f (button hidden without priceId) and the API validation of commit 6248dba. Needs a subscription-enabled instance without a configured price; phase New until it exists.

step_description: The membership card is shown but no "Upgrade Plan" or "Renew Plan" button; /en/pricing shows no button under the plan either.
POST /api/v1/subscription/stripe/checkout-session with the user's Bearer token and body {}.
HTTP 400 with message "Bad Request" and the api log contains "Invalid priceId".

name: No double submission in the account detail and access dialogs
step_description: Sign in, open /en/accounts, open the detail dialog of a cash account and switch to the Cash Balances tab with the network tab recording.
description: Regression check of the isSubmitting guards from release 3.94.0 in the account detail dialog (gf-account-balances) and the create or update access dialog.

step_description: Enter value 100 and yesterday's date in the footer row and double-click "Add" as fast as possible.
Exactly one POST /api/v1/accounts/<id>/balances is sent, the button is disabled until the response arrives and the table shows one row for yesterday.
Open /en/account/access, open the dialog to add a public access with alias "double-click test", and press Enter three times quickly.
One POST /api/v1/accesses is sent and GET /api/v1/accesses lists exactly one access with alias "double-click test"; delete it afterwards.

name: Filter the activities table by type
step_description: Sign in as a user who has BUY and DIVIDEND activities and open /en/portfolio/activities in a desktop-sized window.
description: Checks the Type multi-select of gf-activities-table and the activityTypes parameter of GET api/v1/activities (general availability since 3.93.0).

step_description: A "Type" multi-select is shown above the table listing the user's activity types in alphabetical order of their labels.
Select Dividend only.

Only dividend rows are listed, the paginator is on the first page and the network tab shows GET /api/v1/activities with activityTypes=DIVIDEND whose count equals the paginator total; clearing the selection lists all activities again and the parameter is gone.

name: Pet update by path id and future birth date rejection
step_description: PUT http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners/2/pets/2 with Content-Type application/json and {"name":"Basil II","typeId":6,"birthDate":"2012-08-06"}.
description: Checks the path-id update of commit e8b747a and the @PastOrPresent validation of commits 1e7ecb8 and a3f9d06 against the seed data (owner 2 Betty Davis, pet 2 Basil). Needs the docker compose stack on port 8080.

step_description: HTTP 204; GET http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners/2/pets/2 returns id 2, name "Basil II", owner "Betty Davis" and type.id 6.
PUT http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners/2/pets/99 with the same body.
HTTP 404 and GET http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners/2 still lists one pet.

POST http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners/2/pets with {"name":"Rex","typeId":2,"birthDate":"<today plus one year>"}, then PUT .../owners/2/pets/2 with {"name":"Basil","typeId":6,"birthDate":"<today plus one year>"}.
Both calls return HTTP 400; GET /api/customer/owners/2 lists only Basil with birth date 2012-08-06 (restore the name with a PUT if needed).

name: Add a visit and read visits per pet and for several pets
step_description: Open http://localhost:8080/owners/details/6 and click "Add Visit" next to Samantha.
description: Checks VisitResource create and the two read endpoints through the gateway and the Vue visits page, using the seed visits of pets 7 and 8.

step_description: Keep today's date, type "annual check-up" in Description and click "Add New Visit".
The app returns to /owners/details/6 and "annual check-up" is listed under Samantha; the network tab shows POST /api/visit/owners/6/pets/7/visits answered with HTTP 201 and petId 7.
GET http://localhost:8080/api/visit/owners/6/pets/7/visits and GET http://localhost:8080/api/visit/pets/visits?petId=7,8.

The first lists "rabies shot" (2013-01-01), "spayed" (2013-01-04) and "annual check-up"; the second returns {"items":[...]} with those three plus "rabies shot" (2013-01-02) and "neutered" (2013-01-03) of pet 8, each item with its own petId.

name: Owner details aggregation keeps working with visits-service stopped
step_description: GET http://localhost:8080/api/gateway/owners/6 with the full docker compose stack running.
description: Regression check of ApiGatewayController.getOwnerDetails and its circuit breaker fallback (empty visits, 10 second time limiter).

step_description: HTTP 200 with firstName Jean, lastName Coleman, telephone 6085552654 and pets Max and Samantha, each with two visits.
Run docker compose stop visits-service, wait until http://localhost:8761 no longer lists VISITS-SERVICE, and repeat the GET.
HTTP 200 within about 10 seconds with the same owner and pets and "visits": [] for both; after docker compose start visits-service and its registration, the visits are back.

name: Vue shell for deep links and 503 fallback
step_description: GET http://localhost:8080/owners/details/3 with header Accept: text/html, then GET http://localhost:8080/api/customer/owners with the same header.
description: Regression check of the routerFunction added with the Vue migration (commit dc9ca15) and of the /fallback answer when a routed service is down.

step_description:
The first returns HTTP 200 text/html containing
; the second returns the JSON owner list with Content-Type application/json.
Run docker compose stop customers-service and open http://localhost:8080/owners in the browser.

GET /api/customer/owners returns HTTP 503 with "The requested service is currently unavailable. Please try again later." and the page shows "Owner data is temporarily unavailable."; run docker compose start customers-service afterwards.
